thread:
maria_ops: Quick heads-up — vendor emailed: partial ETA moved up to next-mon morning but customs flagged 3 units for additional inspection. They want decision on interim loaners vs. air-expedite. tagging @claudia_vendor :eyes:

claudia_vendor: we can hold the 3 under inspection, vendor can release 6 units immediately. loaner pool has 4 available in FRA as of this morning. to air-expedite the 3 cleared units it's +€1,200/unit (carrier premium) and needs PO amendment. :ship:

jonathan_procure: cost math — air-expedite (3 units) = +€3.6k. loaner flow (move 4 from FRA -> AMS -> T1 rack) = carrier + crossdock fees ~€900 total but adds 18-24h routing. which is cheaper depends on latency tolerance for the fleet.

sam_sre: cluster impact: if we lose those 3 for 72h we'd drop Dedicated pool throughput by ~12% for eu-west-1 qps peak windows. We have queued jobs that could run on spot fallback for 36h, after that SLOs degrade.

maria_ops: Ops asks: can we accept the 18-24h loaner route and mitigate with batching + short fallback? Or we pay for air? also consideration: RMA paperwork may push cleared units to depot hold for inspection another 12-48h.

claudia_vendor: vendor note — customs flagged firmware label mismatch on 3 H100s. they offered to fast-track paperwork if we sign temporary release waiver (standard A7). waiver required by vendor to avoid full return-to-RMA flow. if waived, vendor assumes customs rework risk, but invoice hold remains until docs reconcile.

jonathan_procure: quick callout: legal needs to sign waiver. if vendor takes risk we should still withhold 50% of expedite fee until docs clear. propose: waive -> loaner route while vendor pays 50% expedite if customs delays >48h.

europe_logistics_bot: [automated] AWB assigned: AWB# GB123456789. Current status: In transit -> customs hold FRA hub. ETA updated to 2026-03-25 07:30 CET (subject to release). Tracking: https://track.carrier/GB123456789

sam_sre: two operational options: 1) accept loaners from FRA -> add temporary route in routing-table to prefer FRA pool for eu-west-1 for 48h; 2) approve air-expedite for 3 units now, recover latency immediately. preference: 1 for cost, 2 for worst-case SLO preservation.

maria_ops: what's timeline for legal/finance to OK waiver + 50% hold? need answer before 15:00 CET today to meet vendor window.

jonathan_procure: finance + legal pinged. finance okay with 50% hold if legal signs waiver. legal review estimate 3h.

claudia_vendor: vendor can reserve the 6 immediate-release units until EOD if we confirm loaner routing. they will not ship the 3 flagged units unless waiver signed.

maria_ops: decision proposal: take loaner route now (move 4 from FRA), sign waiver to speed 3 flagged units but do not air-expedite unless legal flags >24h. if customs still holds at +48h then approve air-expedite and split expedite fee per jonathan's 50% hold. anyone object? :thinking:

sam_sre: +1. please add temporary routing rule and a short memo in incident doc for audit. I will add throttles to canary traffic to limit impact.

jonathan_procure: +1. I'll prepare PO amendment stub and the 50% hold clause. will send to legal now.

ops-oncall: tagging for heads up on potential capacity drop 3-4 days; will monitor.

claudia_vendor: noted. reserving 6 units. vendor will share paperwork PDF in 30-60m once waiver wording confirmed.

maria_ops: thanks all. follow-ups: jonathan -> legal/PO, sam -> routing update, ops-oncall -> monitoring dashboard alert, claudia -> paperwork. I'll update the thread with AWB changes. :thumbsup:
